source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool Test procedure: 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Error Reporting: True c. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Operation Mode: Programmable Mode d. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Fault Recovery: Always e. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → Release SPD Host Control: Disabled f. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → PMFW Poll DDR5 Telemetry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 0 Enable: I2C Enabled h. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 1 Enable: I2C Enabled i. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 2 Enable: I2C Enabled j. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 3 Enable: I2C Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listvalidumc 6. Fatal error injection: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjpmicerrors --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --railtype 7 --voltagetype 0 --dimm 0 6.1 The system will reset immediately. 6.2 When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log. 7.Repeat step 1 to step 6 for all DIMMs with different voltagetype as 0/1. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Fatal Error - Critical Temp Shutdown: inject the DDR PMIC Fatal Error - Critical Temp Shutdown via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'PMIC|power.good|critical|over.current|over.voltage|switchover|temperature|current.limit'; echo __DDR_PMIC_Fatal_Error_-_Critical_Temp_Shutdown; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.test_name: Fatal Error - Critical Temp Shutdown — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Inject a synthetic DDR5 PMIC critical-temperature shutdown condition for each applicable DIMM, prove the intended protective power action and fresh PMIC thermal evidence, then verify the device cooled logically, memory retrained and no real thermal excursion occurred.
required_package: Vendor proof railtype7 selects synthetic PMIC Critical Temperature Shutdown and whether voltagetype is valid/ignored
Critical threshold, hysteresis, status/latch/clear semantics and real sensor safety limits
Per-DIMM socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm, PMIC address and thermal sensor mapping
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/OOB path and expected thermal register response
Decision whether expected action is shutdown, reset or staged shutdown/reset with timing
Fresh thermal PMIC/CPER/BERT/SEL evidence, cooldown/restart/training deadlines, memory recovery and restoration
test_case.test_command: Map DIMM/PMIC thermal sensors and I2C addresses; prove railtype7 and any valid comparator parameter; record actual PMIC/DIMM/ambient temperatures and threshold registers; inject one synthetic thermal fault under OOB/power monitoring; distinguish shutdown from reset; capture durable thermal status; enforce cooldown/clear semantics; reboot only as approved, validate memory, and restore PMIC/I2C state.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
